rationale: The candidate reads as a compact cross-mass with a carved central void, and it stays coherent across the four views rather than collapsing into a single-view gesture. The parcel containment appears respected, and the mass does not simply fill the boundary. The road edge is acknowledged by a visible separation/void response, though the access relationship is still somewhat indirect rather than fully amplified. Its main weakness is that the void and section are modest, so the mass still feels slightly generic and box-led compared with the stronger courtyard-and-terrace precedents.
